scope_and_remaining_gaps.performance: IQ4_XS T1 and Q6_K T16/T32/T64 exceed the requested 10% HIP-gap target. Fresh Ollama GGUF runs show the 1B Q8 Llama output agrees across DIRECT/HIP/AMDLLVM, but Qwen3 Coder 30B A3B MoE dynamic generation is about 1.8x slower on DIRECT than HIP despite exact token agreement. A fixed-shape MoE prototype had a promising ~7.6x prefill speedup with 3/3 top-1 matches and high logit cosine, but no dynamic-padding or end-to-end generated-token validation was completed; do not treat it as a shipped improvement. The earlier natural-prompt Qwen mismatch still needs its original prompt for exact replay.
